title: A blocked Wild Exeggcute keeps its committed facing

verification.actor: One prepared WILD Exeggcute (species 102), bound by current identity on the authored canopy at map 33 tile (580,409)
verification.trigger: Keep input neutral while normal Wild AI repeatedly finds no admitted destination from the blocked canopy tile
verification.observable: For 128 continuous completed game frames, Exeggcute stays idle on the same tile with the same facing and no logical commit

setupMutations.change: Use checked teleport to map 33, native Wild spawn at (580,409), and exact identity bind. Do not change its profile, facing, AI timers, terrain, collision, or motion during observation.

limits: Prepared spawning proves the blocked movement response on the real canopy geometry, not natural Headbutt encounter selection.
This covers the reported Exeggcute tree trap and the shared blocked-facing rule for Wild movement.
The checked run must retain all 128 completed frames from one melonDS session.

events.value: Place and bind Exeggcute on the authored blocked canopy tile.
Observe 128 continuous completed frames under normal Wild AI and neutral player input.

stop.condition: The same Exeggcute completes 128 stable frames, or the first facing, position, motion, commit, identity, terrain, or stream failure

invariants: The subject remains species 102 in the Wild role with current identity and attached presentation
Map 33 tile (580,409) remains loaded, colliding authored canopy
Facing and logical position do not change
No motion starts and no logical commit occurs
